themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services and benefits. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, France, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Rassemblement National, and Reform UK advocating for these measures. The policies often include restrictions on immigration, repatriation of migrants, and exclusionary practices in housing, healthcare, and education.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has successfully negotiated 'national priority' policies in coalition agreements with the PP in Andalusia, securing key government positions and implementing measures to limit immigrant access to public services.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Italian government, led by Giorgia Meloni, has adopted similar rhetoric, emphasizing national sovereignty and restricting immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party continues to advocate for policies that prioritize French citizens in public services and benefits, aligning with broader far-right trends.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has pushed for stricter immigration controls and policies that prioritize British citizens, echoing the 'national priority' theme.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The AfD promotes policies that prioritize German citizens, particularly in social welfare and immigration, aligning with the broader European trend.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties in Europe are increasingly targeting LGBTQ+ rights, framing them as part of a broader cultural and ideological battle. This trend is evident in Spain, Italy, France, and Poland, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Rassemblement National, and Prawo i Sprawiedliwość are pushing back against progressive policies, including gender-neutral language, LGBTQ+ education, and anti-discrimination measures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has opposed LGBTQ+ rights in Spain, including efforts to ban gender-neutral language and restrict LGBTQ+ education in schools.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Italian government has faced criticism for rolling back LGBTQ+ protections and promoting traditional family values.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party has consistently opposed progressive LGBTQ+ policies, framing them as threats to French cultural identity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has targeted LGBTQ+ rights in Poland, promoting conservative values and opposing gender-neutral policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has opposed progressive LGBTQ+ policies, aligning with broader right-wing trends in Europe.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is facing a constitutional crisis as it grapples with internal extremism and external protests. The party's rising popularity has sparked mass demonstrations, with critics accusing it of promoting far-right ideologies. This theme is also resonating in France, Italy, and the UK, where far-right parties are similarly facing scrutiny and backlash.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The AfD is holding its federal party congress in Erfurt amid massive protests and internal debates over extremism, with police deploying thousands of officers to maintain order.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party faces legal challenges and internal debates over its extremist ties, particularly ahead of the 2027 presidential election.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Italian government, led by Giorgia Meloni, has faced criticism for its ties to far-right groups and policies that critics argue undermine democratic norms.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK is facing scrutiny over its extremist ties and the controversial statements of its leader, Nigel Farage.

themes.title: Javier Milei's regional alliances and anti-socialism bloc
themes.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei is actively building regional alliances to counter socialism and promote libertarian policies. His government is engaging with like-minded leaders in the U.S., Peru, and Brazil, while also seeking to strengthen ties with Israel. This theme reflects a broader transnational effort to create an anti-socialist bloc in Latin America and beyond.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government is actively pursuing alliances with libertarian and conservative leaders in Latin America, including Peru's Keiko Fujimori and Colombia's Abelardo de la Espriella, while also engaging with U.S. and Israeli officials.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has shown support for Milei's anti-socialist agenda, with figures like Marco Rubio and Donald Trump engaging with Milei on regional issues.

countries.name: 🇵🇪 Peru (external)
countries.note: Milei has strengthened ties with Peru's president-elect, Keiko Fujimori, aligning with her anti-socialist and pro-liberty stance.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Brazil (external)
countries.note: Milei's government is exploring alliances with conservative leaders in Brazil to counter leftist influences in the region.

themes.title: Right-wing coalition governments in Spain
themes.blurb: Spain is witnessing the formation of right-wing coalition governments at the regional level, with the Partido Popular (PP) and Vox joining forces in Andalusia and other regions. These coalitions are implementing policies that reflect far-right priorities, including restrictions on immigration, cultural nationalism, and rollbacks of progressive social policies. This trend is reshaping Spain's political landscape and influencing national debates.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has secured key positions in regional governments, including Andalusia, where it has negotiated policies that prioritize national citizens and restrict immigration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Partido Popular
countries.note: The PP has formed coalition governments with Vox in several regions, adopting far-right policies to maintain power and avoid repeat elections.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 PSOE (opposition)
countries.note: The PSOE has criticized the PP-Vox coalitions, warning of democratic and social setbacks as a result of their policies.
